disclaimerSections.intro: Welcome to the StarFire Computing Power Sharing Platform. By clicking "Agree" and completing registration, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by all the terms of this Agreement.

account.title: 1. Account and Usage Rules
account.content:
1. You shall properly safeguard your account, password, and API keys. Any disclosure, misuse, or loss caused by your own actions shall be borne by you.
2. You shall not use the Platform for any illegal, infringing, fraudulent, malicious, or harmful activities, including distributing malware or infringing the lawful rights of others.
3. You bear full responsibility for the input content you submit and the output content you obtain through the API, and you must ensure they do not infringe any third-party rights or violate applicable laws.

modelContributor.title: 2. Model Contributor Responsibilities (Important)
modelContributor.content:
1. As a model contributor, you are responsible for the source, copyright, license, content safety, and output quality of the models you contribute, and you must ensure they do not violate any third-party rights or applicable laws.
2. You understand and agree that the Platform only provides the technical channel for model sharing and calling, and does not review, endorse, or warrant the content, accuracy, security, or compliance of the models provided by contributors.
3. Any disputes, claims, losses, or legal liabilities arising from the models you contribute shall be borne by you, and the Platform shall not bear any liability arising therefrom.

platformDisclaimer.title: 3. Platform Disclaimer
platformDisclaimer.content:
1. The Platform serves only as a neutral technical service provider for compute and model sharing and calling. It does not inspect, review, or verify the authenticity, legality, security, accuracy, or output content of the models provided by contributors.
2. The Platform makes no express or implied warranties regarding the accuracy, reliability, completeness, or suitability of any content, results, or suggestions generated by any model.
3. To the maximum extent permitted by law, the Platform shall not be liable for any direct or indirect loss, damage, or liability arising from the use of the Platform or any model.

apiUsage.title: 4. API Usage and Billing
apiUsage.content:
1. When using the Platform API, you shall comply with the Platform's calling specifications, rate limits, and billing rules, and use the API only for lawful and compliant purposes.
2. The Platform reserves the right to adjust the availability, functionality, pricing, and rules of the API based on operational needs, and will provide reasonable advance notice.

disclaimerSections.acceptance: If you do not agree to any of the terms of this Agreement, please do not register for or use the Platform.

privacySections.intro: StarFire takes your personal information protection very seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information. By clicking "Agree" and completing registration, you acknowledge that you have read and agree to this Privacy Policy.

collection.title: 1. Information We Collect
collection.content:
1. Registration and Login: To complete registration and login, we collect your email address and verification code.
2. Usage and Invocation: To provide model invocation, billing settlement, and ensure system security, we collect log information such as your IP address, the model name invoked, Token consumption, request time, and status.
3. Device and Logs: To ensure normal service operation and network security, we may collect basic information such as device information, network access method, and interface operation records.

dataUsage.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
dataUsage.content:
1. We use your information only to provide, maintain, and improve Platform services, complete billing settlement, and ensure account security.
2. For the input content you submit and the output content generated through the API, we process it only for the necessary and brief duration required for inference computation. We do not store it long-term, nor do we use it for model pre-training, fine-tuning, or other commercial purposes.
3. Without your consent, we will not use your personal information for purposes not described in this Policy.

sharing.title: 3. Sharing and Disclosure
sharing.content:
1. Except in the following circumstances, we will not share your personal information with any third party: with your explicit consent; as required by laws, regulations, litigation, or regulatory authorities; or as necessary to provide services such as payment or identity verification.
2. We share only the necessary information for lawful, proper, necessary, specific, and clear purposes, and require partners to assume strict confidentiality obligations.

security.title: 4. Security of Your Information
security.content:
1. We adopt technical and management measures that meet industry standards to protect your information, including encryption, anonymization, and access control.
2. Although we make every effort to protect your information, the Internet environment cannot guarantee 100% security. Please properly safeguard your account, password, and API keys, and do not disclose verification codes to anyone.

userRights.title: 5. Your Rights
userRights.content:
1. You have the right to query, correct, supplement, or delete your personal information, and to withdraw your consent or cancel your account.
2. To exercise these rights, you may contact us through the channels provided on the Platform, and we will process your request within a reasonable period.

privacySections.acceptance: If you do not agree to this Privacy Policy, please do not register for or use the Platform.
